company_name: Sector Perspective: Windfall Tax Relief & Refiner Net Realizations
headline: Sector Perspective: Windfall Tax Relief & Refiner Net Realizations
flowing_prose: The central government's reduction in the Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED / windfall tax) on domestic crude oil and refined fuel exports directly widens net margin realizations for domestic refiners and upstream producers. Beneficiaries such as MRPL, ONGC, and downstream marketing companies retain higher post-tax crack spreads across diesel and jet fuel dispatches.
causal_chain: Windfall tax reduction -> Elimination of export duty friction -> Wider post-tax crack spreads

company_name: Sector Perspective: Crude Price Escalation & Downstream Margin Squeeze
headline: Sector Perspective: Crude Price Escalation & Downstream Margin Squeeze
flowing_prose: Elevated international crude benchmarks translate into prompt input cost inflation for domestic downstream consumers, led by aviation turbine fuel (ATF) for airlines and petrochemical monomers for paint manufacturers. Operating margins for volume leaders including InterGlobe Aviation (IndiGo) and Asian Paints encounter near-term margin friction until raw material price increases can be passed through.
causal_chain: Crude oil rally -> ATF & monomer cost surge -> Near-term margin compression
